# HeadWell

> HeadWell is a free headache and migraine tracking app for iPhone, iPad and Android. People with recurring headaches use it to log attacks and early warning signs, mark where it hurts on a head map, record triggers, periods and life events, see their history in a calendar and charts, and create a report for their doctor. It also offers breathing and stretching routines and a library of articles. HeadWell is a self-tracking and education tool: it does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition and is not a substitute for medical advice.

## Key facts

- Cost: free to download and use.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad (iOS 18.6 or later) on the App Store; Android (8.0 or later) on Google Play.
- Privacy: no ads, no sale of user data, no third-party analytics or advertising trackers. Optional access to location and to Apple Health (iPhone) or Health Connect (Android). The doctor report leaves out the user's name and email.
- Platform differences: a few features currently differ between iPhone/iPad and Android (for example the size of the article library, custom triggers and in-app account deletion). The Features page lists them.
- Not for emergencies: a sudden, severe or entirely new headache needs urgent medical care.
- Last updated: November 2026.

## Terms used in the app

- Forecast: a daily estimate based on the user's own logged data and, if allowed, local weather. It can be wrong and is not a medical diagnosis or recommendation.
- Journey: a progress view in the Profile tab (headache days, good days, impact questionnaires), with an explanation for every number.
- Action Plans: a short list of optional, gentle suggestions shown after a full headache entry or an early warning sign.
- Attack Mode: a dimmed display option for when bright light is painful.

## Guides

- [How to keep a headache diary your doctor can use](https://vishalpuri2594.github.io/headwell-website/guides/headache-diary.html): What to write down, how long to keep it up, and how to read it back.
- [Common migraine triggers, and how to find yours](https://vishalpuri2594.github.io/headwell-website/guides/migraine-triggers.html): What people report most often, and how to tell a real trigger from a coincidence.
- [The stages of a migraine: prodrome, aura, headache and postdrome](https://vishalpuri2594.github.io/headwell-website/guides/stages-of-a-migraine.html): What each phase feels like, how long it lasts, and why the early signs matter.
- [Headaches and weather: what we know, and how to check for yourself](https://vishalpuri2594.github.io/headwell-website/guides/headaches-and-weather.html): Why so many people blame the weather, what the research says, and how to test it.
- [How to prepare for a headache appointment](https://vishalpuri2594.github.io/headwell-website/guides/preparing-for-a-headache-appointment.html): What to bring, what to say and what to ask, so the time with your doctor counts.
